reproduction_lead.classification: Academic original-research article retyping a purported treaty. Used only as a specific primary-document discovery lead; not a certified official treaty record.
reproduction_lead.bounded_summary: The reproduction dates signature to Kinshasa, 18 September 1989. Article I starts at Tanganyika’s median at 08°17′00″S, continuing through Cape Kipimbi; no median longitude or datum is supplied there. Article III envisages a later demarcation protocol submitted for approval. Article VIII identifies Appendix I, a map signed by both heads of state, and Appendix II, enlarged extracts signed by commission cochairs, including the Tanganyika endpoint. Appendix III concerns Luapula islands. Article X requires ratification and exchange of instruments. Inconsistent Roman numerals for the Panta beacon and transcription/OCR defects prevent treating the retyping as an exact authenticated text. No signed appendices or ratification instruments were acquired.
reproduction_lead.remaining_source_lead: Obtain official or otherwise authenticated signed treaty with Appendix I and Tanganyika sheet(s) of Appendix II, or a government-approved demarcation protocol containing the applicable spatial endpoint. Do not construct a median from the prose.
